paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: GERDA search for bosonic super-WIMPs (60 keV/c2 to 1 MeV/c2). Paper reports both g_ae (AxionElectron) and alpha'/alpha (DarkPhoton) limits. The anchor point g_ae < 3e-12 at 150 keV/c2 is explicitly stated in text/abstract; other points are approximate reads from Fig. 3 (log axis) and should be treated as rough. Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm3 assumed. 90% credible interval.
